summary: I loved it! They do “team sweats” where everyone gets to go do workouts at different local spots together and you get paid to do it. They really promote a team/community with the employees and customers. The return/exchange policy is so forgiving that you hardly have to deal with angry customers. On the first day you get 2 free tops 2 bottoms and 1 outerwear. Employee discount is 60% off ...
